items.en_title: Padre Bernardo (GO) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #(8335) | 13-0
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Padre Bernardo (GO) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 748,800; proposals close Nov 27, 13:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
